title: Show that circular Schur bandwidth follows the arc length
body:
## Summary
- On the length-8 width-1 cycle, every proper arc has Schur bandwidth `min(length+1, n-length-1)`. Deleting one vertex leaves bandwidth 2. Deleting `{2,3,4}` leaves bandwidth 4, with entry `-1/224`.
- The inverse of that complement has norms `163/84`, inside the width-1 Neumann bounds `2` and `6`. The original width does not describe the complement.
- The selected κ is unchanged.
